hook_line: TANVI PATRI, 15, FIRST INDIAN WOMAN IN YOUTH OLYMPIC BADMINTON FINAL

hook_stat.sub: First Indian woman to reach a Youth Olympic badminton final

stats.label: Minutes to beat Japan's second seed Yuzuno Watanabe in the semifinal
Deciding-game score in the three-game semifinal
Indians to reach a Youth Olympic badminton final — after HS Prannoy and Lakshya Sen

diaspora_bullets: India's first-ever women's singles medal at the Youth Olympic Games is assured — at least a silver
Patri faces China's Yi Xin Zhang, the reigning World Junior champion, in the gold-medal match
news_summary: Fifteen-year-old Tanvi Patri beat Japan's second seed Yuzuno Watanabe 21-14, 11-21, 21-19 in a 54-minute semifinal to become the first Indian woman to reach a Youth Olympic Games badminton final.
payoff: The win guarantees India its first-ever women's singles badminton medal at the Youth Olympic Games.
